_说明: 这是第 1～24 关玛雅台词的独立审核稿，不会被游戏读取。
meaning_* 只描述原句必须保留的意思、知识和操作；maya_* 必须由扮演玛雅的 Agent 重新说一遍。
审核通过前，不要把 maya_* 回写到正式剧情或教学文件。
大厅自由活动台词已有独立文件 maya_npc_dialogue.json，本稿只集中关卡剧情与关卡技能教学。

story.meaning_en: You made it. Welcome to the Astronomy Club. Long before telescopes, people used this same sky for direction, seasons, stories, and questions. Tonight you join that long chain.
story.meaning_zh: 你来了。欢迎加入天文俱乐部，我是玛雅。人们看这片天空已经很久了，今晚轮到你亲手试试。
story.maya_en: You made it! People have watched this sky for ages. Tonight, you join that long chain with a record of your own.
story.maya_zh: 你终于来啦！我是玛雅，也是天文社的学姐~从今天开始，你也算正式加入我们天文社这个大家庭啦！人们仰望这片天空已经很久很久了，不过今晚嘛，就该轮到我们的小观测员，亲手写下自己的第一笔啦~

story.meaning_en: The Moon feels familiar, yet its bright face still keeps secrets. Start with the oldest instrument we own: your own eyes. Notice both what they reveal and what they cannot resolve.
story.meaning_zh: 先别碰望远镜，我们从月球开始。用眼睛看看它的轮廓和暗色区域，也留意哪些细节怎么都看不清。
story.maya_en: Hands off the telescope for one minute. Start with the Moon and your own eyes—shape, dark patches, and all the detail that refuses to show itself.
story.maya_zh: 小观测员~望远镜待会儿再碰！先用眼睛看看月球的轮廓和那些暗斑，也记住哪些地方怎么盯都看不清，等会儿你就知道望远镜到底做什么用啦~

story.meaning_en: Careful records were astronomy's first breakthrough. Our routine keeps that habit alive: the Mission Board asks, the cabinet and assembly table prepare, the Observation Pad tests, and the Club Logbook preserves the evidence.
story.meaning_zh: 这里的路线不复杂：任务板接任务，零件柜和组装台做准备，观测台动手看，最后把结果记进日志。
story.maya_en: Our routine is simple: take the question from the board, choose parts at the Parts Cabinet, build at the Assembly Table, observe, then keep the evidence in the Club Logbook.
story.maya_zh: 流程其实很简单啦~先去任务板领题，再到零件柜挑部件，组装台把望远镜装好，接着就能去观测啦！看完记得回来把结果写进观测日志哦~

story.meaning_en: The central circle is the Observation Pad. Parts are stored on the left, assembled at the upper-right table, logged at the lower-left desk, and measured by the green-screen terminal at lower right.
story.meaning_zh: 中央圆台是观测台。左边拿零件，右上角组装，左下角查日志；右下角绿屏终端以后会用到。
story.maya_en: The round platform in the middle is our Observation Pad. The green terminal can wait; tonight, your eyes get the first shift.
story.maya_zh: 看到中间那个望远镜了吗？那就是我们的观测台啦~右下角那台绿屏终端先别管它！~

story.meaning_en: Exactly. Record the Moon's shape and dark maria now; a later refractor view will reveal what changed. Walk to the Observation Pad, press E, then use A/D and W/S to center it. I will stay with you.
story.meaning_zh: 对，先记下现在能看到的样子。走到中央观测台按 E，再用 A/D 和 W/S 把月球移到准星中央。我在旁边看着。
story.maya_en: Exactly. Record the shape and dark patches first; on our second Moon visit, a refractor will show us the crater rims for comparison.
story.maya_zh: 对对，就先把现在肉眼能看到的样子记下来~

story.meaning_en: Let's begin without a telescope. The Moon is bright enough for your eyes.
story.meaning_zh: 先用肉眼找月球。它够亮，不需要望远镜。
story.maya_en: Moon first—no telescope yet. It's bright enough for your own eyes.
story.maya_zh: 先别碰望远镜~抬头找月球就好，它靠眼睛就能轻松找到啦！

story.meaning_en: Try to find it, center it, and really look.
story.meaning_zh: 找到后把它移到中央。先看轮廓，再看那些暗色区域。
story.maya_en: Center it, then take your time. Shape first, dark patches second.
story.maya_zh: 找到啦？那就把月球慢慢移到准星中央~先看看它整体的轮廓，再仔细找找表面那些暗色区域，记住现在能看清多少哦！

story.meaning_en: Nice. Your eyes collected light from the Moon and focused it on your retina.
story.meaning_zh: 很好，第一份肉眼观测有了。月光进入眼睛，最后在视网膜上成像。
story.maya_en: There we go—your first naked-eye record! Moonlight entered your eye and formed an image on your retina.
story.maya_zh: 很好~第一份肉眼观测就算完成啦！你刚才看到的月光进入眼睛后，会被聚焦到视网膜上成像，我们就是这样看见月球的呀~

story.meaning_en: But did you notice? You could see the Moon, but not much detail.
story.meaning_zh: 你能看清它是圆的，也能看见暗色月海。不过更小的地形还是糊在一起。
story.maya_en: You caught the round disc and dark maria, but the smaller terrain still blurred together. That's normal.
story.maya_zh: 你已经能看出月球是圆的，也能认出那些暗色的月海啦~不过再小一点的地形，现在还是会糊成一片，这就是肉眼的极限了

story.meaning_en: Fun fact: those dark patches on the Moon are old lava plains, and every little pit you might make out is a crater - a scar from a rock that slammed into it, sometimes billions of years ago.
story.meaning_zh: 那些暗色大片是古老的熔岩平原，叫月海。小坑是岩石撞出来的环形山，有些已经留在那里几十亿年。
story.maya_en: Those dark maria are ancient lava plains. The little pits are impact craters—some have been sitting there for billions of years.
story.maya_zh: 看到那些暗色的一大片了吗？它们叫月海，其实是很古老的平原~旁边那些小坑就是岩石撞出来的环形山，有些已经安安静静留在那里几十亿年啦

story.meaning_en: The Moon has no air, so nothing erodes those scars. A crater from four billion years ago still looks fresh today.
story.meaning_zh: 月球几乎没有大气和流水，撞击留下的地形很难被磨平。所以很久以前的环形山还能保存到今天。
story.maya_en: With almost no air or running water, the Moon barely erases those scars. That's why ancient craters can still look so crisp.
story.maya_zh: 月球上几乎没有大气，也没有流水一直去冲刷地面，所以那些撞出来的环形山很难被慢慢磨平~有些几十亿年前留下的痕迹，到今天居然还看得到呢

story.meaning_en: That's where telescopes come in.
story.meaning_zh: 肉眼先看到这里。下一次，我们用望远镜把细节找回来。
story.maya_en: Your eyes got us this far. Next time, we let a telescope pull those missing edges back out.
story.maya_zh: 今天先看到这里吧，小观测员~把肉眼能看见的样子记好，下一次我们就搬出望远镜，把刚才糊掉的那些细节一点点找回来~

story.meaning_en: Some stars are bright enough to find with your eyes. Others are too faint.
story.meaning_zh: 今晚换一颗恒星。亮星肉眼能找到，暗一点的就会很吃力。
story.maya_en: New target tonight: a star. Bright ones meet your eyes halfway; faint ones really don't.
story.maya_zh: 今晚我们换颗恒星看看吧~亮一点的星星，肉眼很快就能找到，可要是再暗一些，就没那么容易啦，盯久了都不一定看得见呢

story.meaning_en: Quick primer: a star is a giant ball of hydrogen gas so massive that its own gravity crushes the core until atoms fuse together and release light. That's what you're about to look for.
story.meaning_zh: 恒星主要由炽热气体组成，核心的核聚变不断释放能量。你等下看到的那个小光点，自己就在发光。
story.maya_en: That tiny point is a huge ball of hot gas, making its own light through fusion in the core. Tiny in our sky, not tiny in reality.
story.maya_zh: 别看它在天上只是个小光点呀~恒星其实是一大团炽热的气体，主要是氢和氦，核心一直在进行核聚变，把氢慢慢变成氦，同时放出大量能量，所以你等下看到的那颗星可不是在反射谁的光，它自己就在发光哦！而且恒星的颜色也藏着温度，偏蓝的一般更热，偏红的会凉一些，我们的太阳其实也只是其中很普通的一颗恒星啦~

story.meaning_en: Polaris sits toward the north. See if you can catch it.
story.meaning_zh: 朝北边找北极星。它在肉眼里只会是一个很小的星点。
story.maya_en: Look north for Polaris. Don't wait for a giant sparkle—it will stay a very small point.
story.maya_zh: 朝北边慢慢找北极星吧~别期待看见一个小圆球哦，离我们实在太远了，肉眼里它就只是一个很小的亮点，能把它认出来就很好啦！

story.meaning_en: Polaris gave us direction, but the naked-eye image still gave us almost no structure. We have reached the limit of the instrument we were born with.
story.meaning_zh: 北极星能帮我们辨方向，可肉眼还是看不出多少细节。该让望远镜上场了。
story.maya_en: Polaris showed you north, but not much structure. That's your eyes reaching their limit—not you doing anything wrong.
story.maya_zh: 北极星认出来啦？它可是夜空里很好用的“方向标”~不过光靠肉眼，还是只能看到一个小亮点，细节该轮到望远镜上场了！

story.meaning_en: Next we turn that limitation into a design problem. Check the Mission Board, choose the required parts in the cabinet, and meet me at the Assembly Table.
story.meaning_zh: 先去任务板看看要观测什么，再到零件柜拿齐部件。准备好后，来组装台找我。
story.maya_en: So let's build a bigger eye. Check the Mission Board, collect the parts, and meet me at the Assembly Table.
story.maya_zh: 先去任务板看看今晚要观测什么吧~再到零件柜把该拿的部件都找齐，准备好了就来组装台找我，我在这边等你！

story.meaning_en: Your first Moon record has shape and dark maria, but almost no terrain. For thousands of years, that familiar disc remained distant and unresolved.
story.meaning_zh: 第一份月球记录里有轮廓和月海，但环形山还看不清。接下来就拿折射镜补上这些细节。
story.maya_en: Your first Moon record caught the outline and maria, but the crater rims stayed hidden. Good—that gives our refractor a fair challenge.
story.maya_zh: 还记得第一份月球记录吧？轮廓和月海都有了，可那些小环形山还是糊糊的~这次就换折射望远镜上场，把之前没看清的细节一点点补回来！

story.meaning_en: Early-1600s spyglasses changed that. Galileo did not invent the telescope, but he improved one and turned it skyward; glass changed the Moon from a flat symbol into a world with uneven ground.
story.meaning_zh: 17 世纪初，伽利略改进了望远镜并把它指向天空。他不是望远镜的发明者，但月球从此不再只是一个圆盘，人们第一次看清了起伏的地形。
story.maya_en: Galileo didn't invent the telescope, but in the early 1600s he improved one and aimed it upward. Suddenly the Moon wasn't a smooth disc; it had real, uneven ground.
story.maya_zh: 17 世纪初，伽利略把望远镜改得更好用，还真的把它指向了天空~望远镜不是他发明的，不过从那以后，月球在人们眼里就不只是一个亮圆盘啦，山脉、凹坑和那些起伏的地形，第一次变得清清楚楚了

story.meaning_en: Build our refractor in optical order, then return to the same Moon. Compare the maria and crater rims with your first log entry; that difference is the reason to build.
story.meaning_zh: 按光路顺序把折射镜装起来，然后再看一次月球。记得和第一份日志对照，看看环形山边缘多出了多少。
story.maya_en: Build the refractor in optical order, then revisit the same Moon. Compare those crater rims with your first entry—that difference is the whole point.
story.maya_zh: 接下来该让望远镜上场啦~按着光路顺序把折射镜一点点装好，再去看看月球！记得拿第一份日志出来对照一下，看看这次是不是连环形山的边缘都冒出了好多新细节呀~

story.meaning_en: Now the repetition has a result: the dark maria separate from the brighter highlands, and crater rims cast readable edges.
story.meaning_zh: 这次月海和明亮高地分开了，环形山边缘也清楚多了。望远镜补上的就是这些细节。
story.maya_en: Now compare: the maria separate from the bright highlands, and the crater rims finally have readable edges.
story.maya_zh: 看到了吧~这次月海和明亮高地已经能明显分开，连环形山的边缘都清楚多了！你刚才肉眼看不见的那些细节，就是被望远镜一点点补回来的呀~

story.meaning_en: That is why the Club Logbook keeps both sessions. Astronomy advances by comparing evidence, not by collecting two identical check marks.
story.meaning_zh: 这两次都要记下来。等你回头一比，就知道望远镜到底帮了多少忙。
story.maya_en: Keep both sessions in the Club Logbook. The pair tells us more than either pretty view could alone.
story.maya_zh: 这两次可都要好好记下来哦~等会儿把前后的观测日志放在一起比一比，你一眼就能看出来，望远镜到底替我们多看见了多少东西！

story.meaning_en: The telescope is built, but the image may still be blurry. That doesn't mean it's broken.
story.meaning_zh: 望远镜装好了，画面却可能还是糊的。别担心，多半只是焦点没对上。
story.maya_en: Built doesn't always mean sharp. If the image is blurry, wait—don't blame the telescope yet.
story.maya_zh: 望远镜都装好啦，画面还是糊糊的？先别急~大多数时候只是焦点还没对上，轻轻调一调，说不定下一秒月球就清楚啦！

story.meaning_en: Turning the focus knob moves the eyepiece until the image lines up with your eye.
story.meaning_zh: 用 Q/E 慢慢转调焦旋钮。看着目标边缘，朝越来越清楚的方向调。
story.maya_en: Use Q/E gently. Watch the target's edge tighten; if it gets worse, turn back.
story.maya_zh: 用 Q/E 慢慢转调焦旋钮就好~别盯着整颗月球，先看边缘，哪边越来越清楚就继续往哪边调，很快就能找到最清晰的位置啦！

story.meaning_en: There it is. You didn't just look - you adjusted the instrument.
story.meaning_zh: 就是这样。焦点一咬住，图像会突然利落很多。
story.maya_en: There it is! The crater edge just snapped into place—that's the focal plane.
story.maya_zh: 对，就是这个感觉~焦点一旦对准，原本软乎乎的边缘会一下子利落起来！看到最清楚的那一刻就停手，别一高兴又给它拧过去啦~

story.meaning_en: New observers often chase the highest magnification. It feels powerful - but it has a cost.
story.meaning_zh: 新手常常追求最高倍率。听起来很强，但它有代价。
story.maya_en: New observers love the biggest magnification number. I did too. The sky cured me of that pretty fast.
story.maya_zh: 很多新人一上来就想把倍率拉满，可倍率越高，付出的代价也越多，可不是越大就一定看得越清楚哦！

story.meaning_en: Jupiter is a gas giant - no solid ground, just deep layers of hydrogen and helium. It's about 780 million kilometers away and could swallow more than 1,300 Earths.
story.meaning_zh: 木星是一颗气态巨行星——没有固体地面，全是深厚的氢气和氦气层。它离我们大约 7.8 亿公里，体积能装下 1300 多个地球。
story.maya_en: Jupiter is mostly hydrogen and helium, with no solid ground to stand on. Its volume could fit more than 1,300 Earths.
story.maya_zh: 木星可是个大家伙哦~它是一颗气态巨行星，里全是厚厚的氢和氦。它距离太阳大约 7.8 亿公里，体积更夸张，塞下 1300 多个地球都没问题！

story.meaning_en: Watch for its Great Red Spot if the view is sharp enough - a storm bigger than Earth that has been raging for at least 190 years.
story.meaning_zh: 如果画面够清楚，留意它的大红斑——一场比地球还大的风暴，已经刮了至少 190 年。
story.maya_en: If the view holds, look for the Great Red Spot: a storm bigger than Earth, raging for at least 190 years.
story.maya_zh: 要是画面够清楚，记得找找木星的大红斑哦~那可是一场比地球还大的超级风暴，已经在木星上刮了至少 190 年，到现在都没停下来呢！

story.meaning_en: Power is useful only when the view stays clear.
story.meaning_zh: 只有图像还能保持清楚时，倍率才有意义。
story.maya_en: You found the limit: bigger helped only until Jupiter stopped giving you new detail.
story.maya_zh: 记住啦，小观测员~倍率高不高其实没那么重要，只有放大以后画面还能稳稳保持清楚，那些倍率才真的有用，不然就只是把一团糊糊的东西放得更大而已~

story.meaning_en: The refractor shows more, but its narrow field makes the sky harder to navigate. Experienced observers lose targets too; the keyhole is the problem, not your eyesight.
story.meaning_zh: 主镜视野很窄，找不到目标很正常，老手也会丢。不是你眼神不好，是这扇“钥匙孔”确实太小。
story.maya_en: That main-scope view is a keyhole. Experienced observers lose targets too, so don't blame your eyes—the patch of sky really is that tiny.
story.maya_zh: 主镜的视野本来就窄得可怜，找不到目标真的太正常啦，连老手都会一不留神把它弄丢~所以先别怀疑自己的眼神，视野确实就这么大呀！

story.meaning_en: Observers added a small, wide-field finder that points with the main tube. It does not reveal planet detail; it makes a narrow telescope practical.
story.meaning_zh: 所以主镜旁边会装一支宽视场寻星镜。它不负责看细节，只负责先把目标找进来。
story.maya_en: That's why we add a little wide-field finder. It gives no planet detail; it just gets the target through that keyhole.
story.maya_zh: 所以主镜旁边还会带一支宽视场的寻星镜呀~它先帮我们把目标找进来，再交给主镜慢慢看！

story.meaning_en: Align both views on Sirius, then practice the real rhythm: Eye, Finder, Main Scope. It is an observing habit, not just three menu buttons.
story.meaning_zh: 先用天狼星把寻星镜和主镜对齐。以后记住这个顺序：肉眼找方向，寻星镜抓目标，主镜看细节。
story.maya_en: But line it up with the main scope first. Otherwise it will point to the wrong patch of sky with impressive confidence.
story.maya_zh: 先拿天狼星把寻星镜和主镜对齐好~以后就记住这个顺序呀：肉眼先找出方向，寻星镜负责把目标对准到差不多，等它在视野里了，再交给主镜看细节！

story.meaning_en: Wide view to find. Narrow view to study.
story.meaning_zh: 宽视野用来找目标，窄视野用来看细节。
story.maya_en: There—Sirius stayed put in both views. Wide to find, narrow to study.
story.maya_zh: 记住啦~宽视野是拿来找目标的，窄视野才负责盯细节！先找到，再看清，这样就不会在一小片黑漆漆的天空里迷路啦~~

story.meaning_en: The nebula you are hunting tonight is faint - and our 60mm lens is running out of light.
story.meaning_zh: 今晚要找的星云很暗——我们的 60mm 物镜快收集不到足够的光了。
story.maya_en: Tonight's nebula is faint, and our 60 mm objective is running out of light before you are running out of skill.
story.maya_zh: 今晚这个星云可实在太暗了，我们这块 60mm 物镜已经快收不到足够的光了，再这么下去，就看不到什么了！

story.meaning_en: So we upgrade the front of the telescope: a 100mm objective gathers nearly three times the light. Equip it, rebuild, and aim for Orion.
story.meaning_zh: 所以我们升级望远镜的前端：100mm 物镜能收集接近三倍的光。装备它、重新组装，然后瞄准猎户座。
story.maya_en: Swap in the 100 mm objective; it gathers nearly three times as much light. Rebuild the refractor, then take it toward Orion.
story.maya_zh: 那就给望远镜换个100mm 物镜，能收集接近三倍的光！把它装上，重新组好望远镜，然后我们去瞄准猎户座~

story.meaning_en: Mirrors let us build larger light collectors. That matters when targets are faint.
story.meaning_zh: 镜子让我们能制造更大的集光工具。观测暗目标时，这非常重要。
story.maya_en: That brighter patch is the aperture at work. Faint targets need more collected light, not empty magnification.
story.maya_zh: 换成镜面结构以后，我们就能做出更大的集光口径啦~碰上这种又暗又难找的目标时，多收进来一点光，往往比放大更重要！

story.meaning_en: Quick refresher: a nebula is a vast cloud of gas and dust - sometimes glowing, sometimes just blocking light behind it. The Orion Nebula is a stellar nursery, about 1,344 light-years away and roughly 24 light-years wide.
story.meaning_zh: 先复习一下：星云是一大片气体和尘埃云——有的会发光，有的只是挡住后面的光。猎户座大星云是一座恒星育婴房，大约在 1344 光年外，直径约 24 光年。
story.maya_en: A nebula is a huge cloud of gas and dust—sometimes glowing, sometimes blocking light. Orion is a stellar nursery about 1,344 light-years away.
story.maya_zh: 来，先复习一下呀~星云就是一大片气体和尘埃云，有的自己会发光，有的则会把后面的光挡住。我们等会儿要看的猎户座大星云，就是一座巨大的“恒星育婴房”，离我们大约 1344 光年，直径差不多有 24 光年呢！

story.meaning_en: The Orion Nebula is not like the Moon. It's faint. You need light, not just magnification.
story.meaning_zh: 猎户座大星云不像月亮。它很暗。你需要的是光，而不只是倍率。
story.maya_en: It won't behave like the Moon. Keep the field wide and feed your eyes light; don't bully it with magnification.
story.maya_zh: 不过猎户座大星云可不像月亮那么亮呀~它暗得多，所以这次别把倍率拉高，我们缺更多的光，得先想办法把那些微弱的光收集进来才行！

story.meaning_en: New stars are being born inside it right now. That faint purple smudge is a nursery, not a corpse.
story.meaning_zh: 新的恒星正在它内部诞生。那团暗淡的紫色光斑是育婴房，不是废墟。
story.maya_en: New stars are forming inside that faint glow right now. Soft-looking, yes. Empty, absolutely not.
story.maya_zh: 看见那团淡淡的紫光了吗？新的恒星正在里面一点点诞生呢~

story.meaning_en: You collected more light, and the nebula started to appear.
story.meaning_zh: 你收集了更多光，星云才开始显现。
story.maya_en: You gave it enough light, and Orion's faint shape finally came out. Save that view.
story.maya_zh: 就是这样呀~只有收进来的光够多，那团黑暗的星云才会露出来~

story.meaning_en: Andromeda is far beyond our galaxy. It won't look dramatic at first.
story.meaning_zh: 仙女座远在银河系之外。它一开始不会显得很震撼。
story.maya_en: Andromeda sits far beyond the Milky Way. Through this telescope, it may greet you as one very shy smudge.
story.maya_zh: 仙女座可是在银河系外面呢~不过别期待它一上来就特别震撼，刚找到的时候，往往只是一团很不起眼的微光呀

story.meaning_en: But finding it means you're becoming an observer.
story.meaning_zh: 能在这么暗的天区里把它找出来，已经很像样了。
story.maya_en: Don't chase a poster image. Finding that honest faint glow is tonight's real job.
story.maya_zh: 能在这么暗的天区里把它一点点找出来，已经很厉害啦~别小看这团微光，你可是亲手找到了一整个星系呢！

story.meaning_en: A galaxy is a whole city of stars held together by gravity - Andromeda alone holds roughly one trillion of them.
story.meaning_zh: 星系是靠引力聚在一起的整座恒星之城——仙女座一个星系就有大约一万亿颗恒星。
story.maya_en: A galaxy is a whole city of stars held together by gravity. Andromeda may contain roughly a trillion of them.
story.maya_zh: 你可以把星系想成一座被引力聚在一起的“恒星城市”~像仙女座这么大的家伙，里面可是住着大约一万亿颗恒星呢！

story.meaning_en: It's about 2.5 million light-years away, and here's the wild part: it's falling toward us. In about 4 billion years, Andromeda and the Milky Way will merge into one galaxy.
story.meaning_zh: 它在大约 250 万光年外，而且有个疯狂的事实：它正朝我们坠落。大约 40 亿年后，仙女座会和银河系合并成一个星系。
story.maya_en: It's about 2.5 million light-years away and moving toward us. In roughly 4 billion years, Andromeda and the Milky Way are expected to merge.
story.maya_zh: 它离我们大概有 250 万光年，不过最有意思的是——仙女座其实一直在朝银河系靠近哦~再过大约 40 亿年，这两个大家伙很可能会撞到一起，最后慢慢合并成一个新的星系！

story.meaning_en: Tonight, you joined the club. Now you've earned your place in the logbook.
story.meaning_zh: 今晚你加入了俱乐部。现在，你已经值得把名字写进观测日志了。
story.maya_en: You pulled Andromeda out of that dark field. All right—now your name really belongs in the Club Logbook.
story.maya_zh: 今晚你正式加入天文社啦~从现在开始，你也要把自己的名字写进我们的观测日志里了！

story.meaning_en: Welcome, Young Observer.
story.meaning_zh: 欢迎你，年轻的观测者。
story.maya_en: Welcome aboard, little observer. Keep a pen near the log desk—you'll need it.
story.maya_zh: 欢迎你呀，小观测员~以后这片星空，我们就一起看啦！

story.meaning_en: Same Jupiter, new question: how much power is too much?
story.meaning_zh: 还是木星。今晚别只顾着放大，看看倍率升到哪里开始得不偿失。
story.maya_en: Jupiter again, but with a sneaky question: when does more power stop helping?
story.maya_zh: 今晚还是看木星~不过别急着把倍率一下子拧上去呀，慢慢加，看看从什么时候开始，木星虽然变大了，细节反而越来越糊，那差不多就是今晚的极限啦~

story.meaning_en: You can see Jupiter now. Push the power higher - and watch what it costs.
story.meaning_zh: 你已经能看到木星了。把倍率推高试试——看看代价是什么。
story.maya_en: Raise the magnification step by step. Watch brightness, steadiness, and detail—not just size.
story.maya_zh: 已经找到木星啦？那就来点刺激的~把倍率一往上推，别只盯着它变大，看看亮度、清晰度和细节。

story.meaning_en: You can now assemble, aim and focus the refractor. From here on, the telescope is not the only thing that can go wrong.
story.meaning_zh: 折射镜的组装、瞄准和调焦，你都已经会了。接下来要对付的，是天空自己。
story.maya_en: You can build, aim, and focus the refractor now. Nice. From here on, the telescope isn't the only thing with opinions.
story.maya_zh: 折射镜这边你已经很熟练啦~接下来可不是望远镜了……这片天空。

story.meaning_en: The next nights add darkness, clouds, atmospheric motion and Earth's rotation. Same instrument, harder sky. That is how we separate equipment skill from observing skill.
story.meaning_zh: 后面的夜晚会遇到暗适应、云层、大气扰动和地球自转。望远镜没变，但你得学会看天况、等时机。
story.maya_en: Dark adaptation, clouds, shaky air, Earth's rotation—the gear stays familiar, but the sky won't. Time to learn when to adjust and when to wait.
story.maya_zh: 后面的夜晚可就没这么省心啦~暗适应、云层、大气抖动，还有地球自己在转，都会来添点麻烦。望远镜还是那一台，但你得慢慢等一等。

story.meaning_en: Mars again - but tonight it hugs the horizon.
story.meaning_zh: 又是火星——但今晚它贴着地平线。
story.maya_en: Mars again—but tonight it's skimming the horizon, right through the messiest air.
story.maya_zh: 又是火星呀~不过今晚它离地平线太近了，位置低想看清楚可没那么容易哦。

story.meaning_en: Mars is a rocky planet about half Earth's size, roughly 228 million kilometers from the Sun. That rust color you'll see is iron oxide dust - the whole planet is basically rusting.
story.meaning_zh: 火星是一颗岩石行星，大小大约是地球的一半，离太阳约 2.28 亿公里。你会看到的那种铁锈红色，就是氧化铁尘埃——整颗行星基本上都在生锈。
story.maya_en: Mars is a rocky world about half Earth's size. That rusty color comes from iron-oxide dust.
story.maya_zh: 火星其实是颗岩石行星，个头差不多只有地球的一半，离太阳大约有2.28亿公里~你看到那红色了吗？那是地表大量的氧化铁尘埃，简单来说呀……这个整个星球有很多铁，这些铁正在生锈！

story.meaning_en: Here's tonight's real lesson though: seeing. When air near the ground is warm and turbulent, it bends starlight randomly, like looking at something through the shimmer above a campfire.
story.meaning_zh: 今晚要留意的是视宁度。空气一乱，星光就会像隔着热浪一样晃起来。
story.maya_en: Tonight, watch the seeing. Turbulent air bends the light around, like the shimmer above a hot road.
story.maya_zh: 今晚还要注意一个东西——视宁度~要是高空的空气不安分，星光就会跟隔着一层热浪似的抖来抖去

story.meaning_en: Low targets near the horizon look through much more of that thick, turbulent air than something overhead. That's why Mars looks mushy tonight - it's not your telescope, it's the sky between you and it.
story.meaning_zh: 火星现在很低，星光要穿过更厚的大气。画面发软，多半不是镜子坏了，是空气在捣乱。
story.maya_en: A low Mars sends its light through much more atmosphere. If it looks mushy, don't accuse the optics yet—the air is the troublemaker.
story.maya_zh: 火星今晚的位置太低啦~所以画面有点糊很正常，先别怀疑镜子，十有八九是空气呢！

story.meaning_en: If the image looks mushy, that's the air - not your telescope. Try backing off the magnification.
story.meaning_zh: 画面一直在抖就先降倍率。别急着拆望远镜，这次多半是空气的问题。
story.maya_en: If the image boils instead of staying steadily blurry, lower the magnification and wait for a calmer moment.
story.maya_zh: 画面一直抖的话，就先把倍率降下来一点~

story.meaning_en: Low targets swim in thick air. Less power, steadier view.
story.meaning_zh: 低空目标泡在厚厚的大气里。倍率低一点，画面稳一点。
story.maya_en: You caught it: low Mars was swimming in thick air. Lower power gave you the steadier view.
story.maya_zh: 低空的目标要隔着厚厚的大气看呀~这种时候倍率稍微降一点，画面反而更稳。

story.meaning_en: Every telescope has a real ceiling on useful magnification once the air itself is unsteady. Pushing past it doesn't show more - it just shows a bigger blur.
story.meaning_zh: 一旦空气本身不稳定，任何望远镜的有效倍率都有一个硬上限。硬要超过它，看到的不是更多细节，只是更大一团模糊。
story.maya_en: Unsteady air puts a hard ceiling on useful magnification. Push past it and you only enlarge the blur.
story.maya_zh: 大气乱流来了倍率其实就已经有上限啦~再硬往上加也不会多出细节 ，小观测员可别被倍率骗啦！

story.meaning_en: Remember tonight's shimmer next time you see a target low in the sky. The rule doesn't change - only the air does.
story.meaning_zh: 下次看到贴近地平线的目标时，想想今晚这种晃动感。规则不会变——变的只是空气。
story.maya_en: Keep tonight's boiling edge in mind. Next time a low target does this, check the sky before blaming your hands.
story.maya_zh: 看到边缘一抖一抖的了吗？以后碰到低空目标又开始晃，先抬头看看天况，别急着怀疑自己是不是哪里做错了。

story.meaning_en: Back to the Moon - the one target that rewards high power.
story.meaning_zh: 回到月亮——唯一奖励高倍率的目标。
story.maya_en: Back to the Moon. It's bright enough to make high magnification earn its dinner.
story.maya_zh: 好啦，回头看月亮吧~看看那些刚才还糊成一片的细节！

story.meaning_en: The Moon is bright enough to take the power. But every new eyepiece needs a new focus.
story.meaning_zh: 月亮够亮，扛得住高倍率。但每换一个目镜，都要重新调焦。
story.maya_en: Change eyepieces as you climb, but refocus every time. The old focal point won't follow along politely.
story.maya_zh: 月亮够亮，高倍率也不怕~不过记住哦，每次换完目镜都得重新对焦，别看到一片糊就急着怪镜子呀！

story.meaning_en: Tonight's air is only average, not poor like Mars's low horizon - you'll still feel a little shimmer, but it won't fight you nearly as hard.
story.meaning_zh: 今晚的大气只是一般水平，不像火星贴地平线时那么糟——你还是会感觉到一点晃动，但不会像那晚那么难缠。
story.maya_en: The seeing is average tonight—still a little shimmer, but nothing like that low Mars session.
story.maya_zh: 今晚视宁度一般，会有一点晃，但没低空火星那晚那么折腾。

story.meaning_en: Since we're staring at craters tonight: most of them formed when the Moon had no atmosphere to burn up incoming rocks, so even small impactors punched straight through to the surface.
story.meaning_zh: 既然今晚要盯着环形山看：它们大多是在月球没有大气层、无法烧毁来袭岩石的情况下形成的，所以哪怕是很小的撞击体也能直接砸到地表。
story.maya_en: Most of those craters formed because the Moon has no atmosphere to burn up incoming rocks—even small ones can slam straight into the surface.
story.maya_zh: 月球没有大气替来袭岩石挡一挡，小石块也会直撞地表；这些环形山大多就是这么来的。

story.meaning_en: Push the power up, then re-focus - the Moon can handle it.
story.meaning_zh: 把倍率推高，然后重新调焦——月亮扛得住。
story.maya_en: Bump up the power, then focus again. The Moon is bright enough to take it.
story.maya_zh: 倍率往上加，再重新对焦。月亮够亮，撑得住。

story.meaning_en: Same rule, different target: brightness pays for power.
story.meaning_zh: 同一条规则，不同的目标：亮度为倍率买单。
story.maya_en: You pushed the power and still pulled out the detail—same rule as before: brightness buys magnification.
story.maya_zh: 倍率推上去还能看清吧？还是那条：目标够亮，才有本钱上高倍率。

story.meaning_en: A dim target and average seeing would have punished that same high power tonight. The Moon's brightness is what bought you the detail.
story.meaning_zh: 换成暗弱目标，同样这点大气扰动今晚就会惩罚你用高倍率。月亮的亮度才是你能看清细节的原因。
story.maya_en: Try that same high power on a faint target in tonight's average seeing and it would fall apart. The Moon's brightness is what let you see the detail.
story.maya_zh: 要是换成暗目标，今晚这点晃动早把高倍率拖垮了。是月亮够亮，才让你看清细节。

story.meaning_en: Same aperture as the Moon needs high power - a faint galaxy needs the opposite. Keep that trade in your pocket for later.
story.meaning_zh: 月亮这样的目标才配得上高倍率——暗弱的星系恰恰相反。把这条权衡记在心里，以后用得上。
story.maya_en: With the same aperture, the Moon can take high power; a faint galaxy needs the opposite. Tuck that tradeoff away for later.
story.maya_zh: 同一口径下，月亮适合高倍率，暗星系却正相反。记住这笔取舍，之后用得上。

story.meaning_en: Your call tonight. Pick a target, pick the power. I'm just watching.
story.meaning_zh: 今晚你说了算。选目标，选倍率。我只旁观。
story.maya_en: Your call tonight: choose the target and the power. I won't step in.
story.maya_zh: 今晚你做主：目标和倍率都由你选。我不插手。

story.meaning_en: Same average air as usual tonight - nothing dramatic, just the normal little shimmer you've gotten used to by now.
story.meaning_zh: 今晚还是那种一般水平的空气——没什么特别的，就是你已经习惯的那点小晃动。
story.maya_en: The air's its usual average self tonight—nothing dramatic, just that little shimmer you know by now.
story.maya_zh: 今晚大气还是老样子，一般般，只有你已经熟悉的那点轻微晃动。

story.meaning_en: No hint circle judgment tonight either, just your own eye and your own plan.
story.meaning_zh: 今晚也没有提示圈来评判——只有你自己的眼睛和自己的计划。
story.maya_en: No hint circle making the call this time, either. Just your eyes and your own plan.
story.maya_zh: 这次也没有提示圈替你判断，只看你的眼睛和你的打算。

story.meaning_en: Whatever you pick - a planet with real cloud bands, a scarred old moon, or a star burning hydrogen light-years away - the same question applies: what power actually serves this object?
story.meaning_zh: 不管你选行星、月球还是恒星，都先从低倍率看起。画面稳了，再一点点往上加。
story.maya_en: Whether you choose a banded planet, the cratered Moon, or a hydrogen-burning star light-years away, start low. Once the view settles, raise the power bit by bit and see what the target can support.
story.maya_zh: 不管选行星、月球还是恒星，都先从低倍率看起；画面稳了再慢慢加，看看它究竟撑得住多少。

story.meaning_en: You chose like an observer, not a beginner. Chapter logged.
story.meaning_zh: 你的选择像个观测者，而不是新手了。本章记入日志。
story.maya_en: That was an observer's choice, not a beginner's. Nice—this chapter's in the log.
story.maya_zh: 这次选得漂亮，已经是观测者的判断了。好，这一章记下啦。

story.meaning_en: Magnification Mastery is yours. Next up: finding things in the first place.
story.meaning_zh: 「倍率掌握」徽章归你了。接下来：学会怎么先找到目标。
story.maya_en: The Magnification Mastery badge is yours! Next up: learning how to find the target in the first place.
story.maya_zh: 「倍率掌握」徽章到手！下一课，学怎么先把目标找出来。

story.meaning_en: Whichever target you picked, the logic held: match the power to what the object can actually support.
story.meaning_zh: 不管你选了哪个目标，逻辑都成立：倍率要匹配目标本身能撑住的程度。
story.maya_en: Whichever target you chose, your logic was solid: use only as much power as the object can actually support.
story.maya_zh: 不管你选了谁，刚才的思路都对：倍率得配得上目标本身能承受的程度。

story.meaning_en: Mars a third time - but tonight you navigate by numbers, not by luck.
story.meaning_zh: 第三次找火星——但今晚靠数字导航，不靠运气。
story.maya_en: Third time finding Mars! Tonight we're following the numbers, not crossing our fingers.
story.maya_zh: 第三次找火星啦。今晚不碰运气，我们跟着数字走。

story.meaning_en: No guessing tonight. Two numbers will take you to Mars: azimuth and altitude.
story.meaning_zh: 今晚不用猜。两个数字就能带你找到火星：方位角和俯仰角。
story.maya_en: No guessing tonight. Two numbers will lead you straight to Mars: azimuth and altitude.
story.maya_zh: 今晚别猜，方位角和俯仰角这两个数会把你带到火星。

story.meaning_en: Good news, the air is calm tonight - no fighting turbulence this time. Pure navigation practice.
story.meaning_zh: 好消息，今晚空气很平静——这次不用跟大气扰动较劲，纯粹练导航。
story.maya_en: Good news: the air's nice and steady tonight. No turbulence to wrestle with—just you practicing navigation.
story.maya_zh: 好消息，今晚空气很稳，不用对付扰动，专心练导航吧。

story.meaning_en: Mars has two tiny, lumpy moons, Phobos and Deimos. They may be captured asteroids, or they may have formed from debris after an ancient giant impact; their origin remains uncertain.
story.meaning_zh: 火星有两颗又小又坑洼的卫星：火卫一和火卫二。它们可能是被捕获的小行星，也可能形成于远古巨撞留下的碎屑，起源仍未确定。
story.maya_en: Fun Mars fact: its tiny, lumpy moons, Phobos and Deimos, may be captured asteroids—or debris left by an ancient giant impact. Their origin is still a mystery.
story.maya_zh: 顺带一提，火卫一和火卫二又小又坑洼。它们可能是火星抓来的小行星，也可能来自远古撞击留下的碎屑——身世到现在还是个谜~

story.meaning_en: Coordinates turned the whole sky into an address book.
story.meaning_zh: 坐标把整个天空变成了一本地址簿。
story.maya_en: There you go—you just turned the whole sky into an address book with coordinates.
story.maya_zh: 漂亮！你用坐标给整片天空都编上地址了。

story.meaning_en: No shimmering air to blame tonight, no luck involved either - just you, the numbers, and a steady hand on the dials.
story.meaning_zh: 今晚没有晃动的空气可以怪罪，也没有运气的成分——只有你、数字，还有转动旋钮的稳定的手。
story.maya_en: That was all you—no shimmering air to blame and no lucky break. Just the numbers and your steady hand on the dials.
story.maya_zh: 这次可全是你的本事：读准数字，稳稳转好旋钮，和运气没关系。

story.meaning_en: Once you can read azimuth and altitude, you know where to look even when the target is hard to spot.
story.meaning_zh: 一旦能读懂方位角和仰角，即使目标不显眼，也知道该往哪里找。
story.maya_en: Now that you can read azimuth and altitude, even a shy target can't hide where you should look.
story.maya_zh: 会读方位角和仰角后，就算目标不显眼，你也知道该往哪儿找啦。

story.meaning_en: A finder fresh out of the box lies a little. Let's teach it to point true.
story.meaning_zh: 刚装上的寻星镜会撒点小谎。我们来教它指准。
story.maya_en: A finder fresh out of the box likes to fib a little. Let's teach this one to point straight.
story.maya_zh: 新装的寻星镜总爱撒点小谎，来教它老实指准。

story.meaning_en: Center a bright star in the main scope, then nudge the finder until it agrees.
story.meaning_zh: 先在主镜里把一颗亮星居中，再微调寻星镜直到它也对准。
story.maya_en: First center a bright star in the main scope. Then adjust the finder until it's pointing at the exact same spot.
story.maya_zh: 先用主镜把亮星放正中央，再微调寻星镜，让它也瞄准同一点。

story.meaning_en: Tonight's sky is calm, just average seeing - nothing to fight. I want your full attention on the calibration, not the atmosphere.
story.meaning_zh: 今晚的天空很平静，只是一般视宁度——没什么好对付的。我希望你把全部注意力放在校准上，而不是大气上。
story.maya_en: The sky's calm tonight, with perfectly average seeing. Nothing atmospheric to fight—give the calibration your full attention.
story.maya_zh: 今晚很平静，视宁度一般，但不碍事；把注意力都放在校准上吧。

story.meaning_en: A finder that lies by even half a degree can send you hunting the wrong patch of sky at high power.
story.meaning_zh: 寻星镜哪怕只偏差半度，在高倍率下都可能让你在错误的天区里瞎找。
story.maya_en: Even half a degree of finder error can send you searching the wrong patch of sky once you switch to high power.
story.maya_zh: 寻星镜只偏半度，换到高倍后都可能让你在错误天区白找半天。

story.meaning_en: Now your wide eye and your narrow eye agree.
story.meaning_zh: 现在你的'宽眼睛'和'窄眼睛'终于一致了。
story.maya_en: Nice work—your wide-field eye and narrow-field eye are finally looking at the same spot.
story.maya_zh: 校得真准！现在宽视野和窄视野终于看向同一点了。

story.meaning_en: Do this once per session and trust the finder all night. A finder that lies wastes more time than it ever saves.
story.meaning_zh: 每次观测前做一次这个校准，剩下的时间就能放心信任寻星镜了。撒谎的寻星镜浪费的时间比它省下的还多。
story.maya_en: Calibrate once at the start of each session, and you can trust the finder all night. A finder that fibs wastes more time than it saves.
story.maya_zh: 每次开观测前校准一次，整晚都能放心用；不准的寻星镜只会更费时间。

story.meaning_en: Skip this step and you'll spend the whole night hunting through the wide finder for something that isn't where it points.
story.meaning_zh: 跳过这一步，你会花一整晚在宽视野寻星镜里找一个根本不在它指向位置的目标。
story.maya_en: Skip that calibration and you could spend all night combing the finder's wide view for a target that isn't where it says.
story.maya_zh: 跳过校准，你可能整晚都在宽视野里找一个根本不在指向处的目标。

story.meaning_en: Feeling confident? Try finding it with the main scope alone.
story.meaning_zh: 自信满满？那就试试只用主望远镜找它。
story.maya_en: Feeling confident? All right—try finding it with the main scope alone this time.
story.maya_zh: 信心满满了？那这次只用主望远镜找到它试试。

story.meaning_en: Tonight's air is the same calm average as last time - the challenge is entirely about the workflow, not the atmosphere.
story.meaning_zh: 今晚空气很稳，可以专心练操作。要是丢了目标，就从寻星镜那一步重新来。
story.maya_en: The air's just as calm and average as last time, so this is all about your workflow. If you lose the target, start over with the finder.
story.maya_zh: 今晚空气还是很稳，专心练流程就好。要是丢了目标，就从寻星镜那步重来。

story.meaning_en: Six degrees of sky looks huge when you don't know where you're pointed. Go on, try it solo first.
story.meaning_zh: 不知道自己指向哪里时，6 度的天空看起来大得吓人。去吧，先自己试试。
story.maya_en: Six degrees of sky feels enormous when you don't know where you're pointing. Go on—give it a solo try first.
story.maya_zh: 不知道镜筒指向哪儿时，六度天空大得吓人。去吧，先自己试试。

story.meaning_en: No finder, no hint circle mentioned yet - just you, the 6-degree eyepiece, and whatever confidence you walked in with.
story.meaning_zh: 没有寻星镜，也还没提示圈——只有你、6 度的目镜视野，还有你走进来时的那点自信。
story.maya_en: No finder, no hint circle tonight—just a six-degree eyepiece field and the confidence you brought with you.
story.maya_zh: 寻星镜和提示圈都没有。就凭这6度视野，还有你的底气啦。

story.meaning_en: Lost? Everyone gets lost in six degrees. Wide first, narrow last.
story.meaning_zh: 迷路了吧？在 6 度的视野里谁都会迷路。先宽后窄。
story.maya_en: Lost? Everyone takes a wrong turn in a six-degree field. Remember: wide first, narrow later.
story.maya_zh: 迷路啦？6度视野里谁都绕过弯。记住，先宽后窄。

story.meaning_en: The narrow field shows detail. The wide field shows the way.
story.meaning_zh: 窄视野看细节，宽视野认路。
story.maya_en: The narrow field brought out the detail; the wide field showed you the way. Nice teamwork.
story.maya_zh: 窄视野看细节，宽视野认路。刚才配合得很漂亮。

story.meaning_en: Jupiter has more than 100 known moons. Through your telescope tonight you might catch the four Galilean moons—Io, Europa, Ganymede, and Callisto—as tiny points lined up beside it.
story.meaning_zh: 木星已知有 100 多颗卫星。今晚透过望远镜，也许能看到四颗伽利略卫星——木卫一、木卫二、木卫三、木卫四——像小光点排在它旁边。
story.maya_en: One more Jupiter fact: it has more than 100 known moons. Tonight you may spot Io, Europa, Ganymede, and Callisto lined up beside it like tiny points of light.
story.maya_zh: 再送你一个木星知识：它有100多颗已知卫星。今晚也许能看到木卫一、木卫二、木卫三和木卫四，像小光点排在它身旁。

story.meaning_en: Everyone learns this the hard way once. Better tonight, in practice, than during a real observation you cared about.
story.meaning_zh: 这一步谁都会手忙脚乱。趁今晚多试几次，以后遇到难找的目标就不慌了。
story.maya_en: Everyone fumbles through this once. Practice it a few more times tonight, and the next hard-to-find target won't throw you.
story.maya_zh: 刚才那阵手忙脚乱，大家都经历过。今晚多练几回，下次找难目标就稳啦。

story.meaning_en: Tonight I stay by the door. The sky is yours.
story.meaning_zh: 今晚我就站在门口。天空交给你了。
story.maya_en: I'll stay by the door tonight—no leading the way. The whole sky is yours.
story.maya_zh: 今晚我守在门口，不给你带路。整片天空，交给你啦。

story.meaning_en: New wrinkle tonight: thin cloud is drifting through. Watch the target dim and brighten as patches pass over it.
story.meaning_zh: 今晚有个新麻烦：薄云正在飘过天空。你会看到目标随着云块经过而忽暗忽亮。
story.maya_en: There's thin cloud drifting through tonight. As each patch crosses, the target will dim and brighten—don't let that fool you.
story.maya_zh: 今晚多了层薄云。云块飘过时，目标会忽暗忽亮，别被它骗啦。

story.meaning_en: Waiting for a gap in the clouds is a real observing skill, not a failure. Every astrophotographer spends half their night watching the sky and the other half watching the clouds.
story.meaning_zh: 云挡住了就等一等。天文观测有时候就是这么磨人，等到云缝再按观测。
story.maya_en: If cloud covers the target, wait for a gap before you observe. Astrophotographers spend half the night watching the sky and half watching clouds—waiting well is a real skill.
story.maya_zh: 云挡住先别按，等云缝露出来再观测。天文摄影常有半晚看天、半晚看云，会等也是本事。

story.meaning_en: Combine that with average seeing and no hint circle, and tonight is the real final exam for everything Chapter 4 taught you.
story.meaning_zh: 今晚视宁度一般，也没有提示圈。把前面学过的找星、调焦和等待都用上吧。
story.maya_en: The seeing is only average tonight, and there's no hint circle. Finding, focusing, waiting—time to use everything Chapter Four taught you.
story.maya_zh: 今晚视宁度一般，也没有提示圈。找星、调焦、等云缝——第四章的真本事都用上吧。

story.meaning_en: You navigated alone. That's the real badge.
story.meaning_zh: 这次我没带路，你也找到了。这个徽章拿得很踏实。
story.maya_en: I didn't lead you, and you still found it on your own. You truly earned this badge.
story.maya_zh: 我没带路，你也独自找到了。这枚徽章，拿得真踏实。

story.meaning_en: You also learned to read a gap in the clouds instead of giving up the moment one crossed your target. That patience will matter even more once we start hunting faint deep-sky objects.
story.meaning_zh: 你还学会了读懂云隙，而不是一遇到云挡住目标就放弃。等我们开始追踪暗弱的深空天体时，这份耐心会更重要。
story.maya_en: You learned to read the gaps instead of quitting when cloud crossed the target. That patience will matter even more when we start hunting faint deep-sky objects.
story.maya_zh: 你还学会了等云缝，而不是一被遮住就放弃。以后追暗弱的深空天体，这份耐心更管用。

story.meaning_en: Sky Navigator, logged. Next, we chase the faint stuff.
story.meaning_zh: 「星空导航」记入日志。接下来，我们要去追暗弱的天体了。
story.maya_en: Sky Navigator is in the log. Next stop: the faint deep-sky objects.
story.maya_zh: 「星空导航」记进日志啦。下一站，去追更暗弱的深空天体。

story.meaning_en: Bright planets answer quickly. Deep-sky objects often begin as almost nothing, and that can make a careful observer doubt their own eyes.
story.meaning_zh: 行星很亮，通常一眼就能认出来。深空天体可没这么配合，刚开始你可能只看到一团很淡的光。
story.maya_en: Bright planets answer at a glance. Deep-sky objects can begin as almost nothing, so don't be too quick to doubt your eyes.
story.maya_zh: 亮行星一眼就有回应，深空天体却常淡得像什么都没有。别急着怀疑自己的眼睛。

story.meaning_en: The club's older notebooks repeat the same lesson: larger aperture, dark-adapted eyes, darker skies, and patience reveal faint structure gradually, never all at once.
story.meaning_zh: 俱乐部旧日志里写得最多的就是这件事：口径要够，眼睛要适应黑暗，天空要暗，还得耐心。淡结构会慢慢冒出来。
story.maya_en: The club's older notebooks say it again and again: more aperture, dark-adapted eyes, darker skies, and patience. Faint structure reveals itself bit by bit.
story.maya_zh: 社团旧日志反复写着：大口径、暗适应、暗天空，再加耐心，淡结构才会一点点显出来。

story.meaning_en: Hold Orion steady and accept an honest soft glow as evidence. That light crossed about 1,300 years to reach us; give it a quiet moment before asking it to be obvious.
story.meaning_zh: 把猎户座星云稳住，多看一会儿。它不会像行星那样跳出来，那团柔和的微光就是你要找的。
story.maya_en: Hold the Orion Nebula steady and give it a quiet moment. That soft glow traveled about 1,300 years to reach us; it doesn't need to shout to count as evidence.
story.maya_zh: 稳住猎户座星云，安静多看一会儿。那团微光走了约1300年才抵达我们，柔柔亮着就已经是证据。

story.meaning_en: You stopped treating clouds, drift and seeing as random punishment. You read them, corrected what you could, and waited when correction would only make things worse.
story.meaning_zh: 你不再把云层、漂移和视宁度当成随机惩罚。能修正的就修正，越动越糟时就等待。
story.maya_en: You've learned to read the sky instead of taking clouds, drift, and bad seeing as random punishment. Fix what you can; when fiddling would only make it worse, wait it out.
story.maya_zh: 你已经会读天空了：能修的就修，越动越糟时就耐心等。

story.meaning_en: Now I will stop isolating one control at a time. The Mission Board will give you a result to obtain; you will decide how the whole observatory gets you there.
story.meaning_zh: 接下来不会一次只练一个按钮了。任务板告诉你要看到什么，怎么配设备、怎么等天况，你自己安排。
story.maya_en: No more practicing one control at a time. The Mission Board gives you the goal; how to set up the observatory and when to wait on the weather are your calls.
story.maya_zh: 接下来不拆成单项练习啦。任务板给目标，设备怎么配、天气怎么等，都由你安排。

story.meaning_en: Third visit to Orion - this time as a controlled experiment.
story.meaning_zh: 第三次看猎户座星云——这次是一场对照实验。
story.maya_en: Third visit to the Orion Nebula—and this time, we're making it a controlled experiment.
story.maya_zh: 第三次看猎户座星云——这回，我们做个对照实验。

story.meaning_en: Same sky, same nebula. Only one thing changes tonight: how much light you collect.
story.meaning_zh: 同样的天空，同样的星云。今晚只改变一件事：你收集多少光。
story.maya_en: Same sky, same nebula. Tonight, we change just one thing: how much light you collect.
story.maya_zh: 天空没变，星云也没变。今晚只改一件事：收集多少光。

story.meaning_en: I cleared the clouds out of tonight's sky on purpose - same average seeing as last time, but nothing else confusing the result. A fair test changes one variable at a time.
story.meaning_zh: 我特意把今晚的云去掉了——视宁度还是和上次一样的一般水平，但没有别的东西会干扰结果。一次公平的实验，一次只改变一个变量。
story.maya_en: I chose a cloudless window with the same average seeing as last time. That keeps the comparison fair: one variable at a time.
story.maya_zh: 今晚特意选了无云时段，视宁度和上次差不多。这样才公平：一次只改一个变量。

story.meaning_en: Equip the larger objective before you observe - light gathering makes the difference.
story.meaning_zh: 观测前先装上更大的物镜——集光能力决定了差别。
story.maya_en: Before you observe, fit the larger objective. The difference here comes from light-gathering power.
story.maya_zh: 观测前先换上大口径物镜。这里比的不是放大，而是谁能收进更多光。

story.meaning_en: Last night a smudge, tonight a shape. That difference is aperture.
story.meaning_zh: 昨晚是一团斑，今晚有了形状。这个差别，就叫口径。
story.maya_en: Last time it was a smudge; tonight it has shape. That's what aperture changes.
story.maya_zh: 上次还是一团斑，今晚已经看得出形状了。这就是口径带来的差别。

story.meaning_en: Notice we didn't touch magnification or the sky. One bigger lens, one clear improvement. That's how you isolate what actually works.
story.meaning_zh: 倍率和天空都没变，只换了大口径物镜。现在亮了多少，你一眼就能比出来。
story.maya_en: We didn't touch the magnification or change the sky—just swapped in the larger objective, and the improvement is obvious. That's how you find what actually worked.
story.maya_zh: 倍率和天空都没变，只换了大口径物镜，提升却一眼可见。这就找到了真正起作用的变量。

story.meaning_en: File this away: when a target is light-starved, the fix is almost always aperture, not magnification or focus.
story.meaning_zh: 记住这条：当目标缺光的时候，解决办法几乎总是加大口径，而不是加倍率或调焦。
story.maya_en: Keep this one handy: when a target is starved for light, the answer is almost always more aperture—not more magnification or another turn of the focus knob.
story.maya_zh: 记住这条：目标缺光时，通常该加大口径，不是加倍率，也不是反复调焦。

story.meaning_en: Andromeda again - but the enemy tonight is streetlights, not distance.
story.meaning_zh: 又是仙女座——但今晚的敌人是路灯，不是距离。
story.maya_en: Andromeda again—but tonight, the enemy isn't distance. It's the streetlights.
story.maya_zh: 又见仙女座。不过今晚的对手不是距离，是街灯。

story.meaning_en: Andromeda is huge - and the city lights are eating it alive.
story.meaning_zh: 仙女座星系很大——但城市的灯光正在活活吞掉它。
story.maya_en: Andromeda is enormous, but the city's glow is swallowing nearly all of it.
story.maya_zh: 仙女座星系其实大得很，可城市灯光正把它一点点吞掉。

story.meaning_en: Think of light pollution like trying to spot fireflies in a room where someone left every lamp on. The fireflies are still there - your eyes just can't pull their faint glow out of all that background light.
story.meaning_zh: 光污染就像在一个所有灯都开着的房间里找萤火虫。萤火虫还在那儿——只是你的眼睛没法从这么多背景光里把它们那点微光分辨出来。
story.maya_en: Light pollution is like looking for fireflies in a room with every lamp on. They're still there; their faint glow just gets lost in all that background light.
story.maya_zh: 光污染就像开着满屋灯找萤火虫。它们还在，只是微光被明亮背景淹没了。

story.meaning_en: Andromeda's apparent span across the sky is about six full Moons wide, but most of it is too faint to see. Light pollution often leaves only its small bright core visible.
story.meaning_zh: 仙女座在天空中的视宽度约为六个满月，但大部分区域太暗而看不见。光污染下通常只剩小小的明亮核心。
story.maya_en: Andromeda actually stretches across about six full Moons in our sky. Most of it is so faint that city glow leaves you only that small, bright core.
story.maya_zh: 仙女座在天空中铺开约六个满月宽，只是外层太暗，城市天光一压，就只剩那个小亮核啦。

story.meaning_en: The glow won't get much sharper tonight - the sky itself is the problem, not your gear.
story.meaning_zh: 先别再拧调焦了。今晚这团光一直发软，是天空不稳，不是设备没调好。
story.maya_en: Don't keep chasing the focus tonight; that glow won't get much sharper. The sky background is the problem, not your gear.
story.maya_zh: 今晚别再追着调焦了，这团光不会清楚多少。问题在天空背景，不在设备。

story.meaning_en: Nothing was broken tonight. The sky itself was the problem. Log it honestly.
story.meaning_zh: 设备没坏，只是今晚空气不配合。照你看到的记，差天气也是观测的一部分。
story.maya_en: Nothing was broken tonight—the sky itself got in the way. Log exactly what you saw; poor conditions are part of observing too.
story.maya_zh: 设备没坏，是今晚的天空不配合。按实记录吧，差天气也是观测的一部分。

story.meaning_en: No amount of aperture fully cures a bright sky. It only buys back some of what the light pollution took.
story.meaning_zh: 再大的口径也治不好一个明亮的天空，它只能帮你从光污染手里抢回来一部分。
story.maya_en: Even a huge aperture can't cure a bright sky. It can only win back some of what light pollution stole.
story.maya_zh: 再大的口径也治不好亮天空，只能抢回被光污染吞掉的一部分。

story.meaning_en: Keep this in mind for every faint target from now on: check the sky before you blame the gear.
story.meaning_zh: 从现在起，遇到任何暗弱目标都记住这条：先检查天空条件，再怀疑设备。
story.maya_en: From now on, when a faint target won't show, check the sky before you blame the gear.
story.maya_zh: 以后暗弱目标看不清，先看看天况，别急着怪设备。

story.meaning_en: The club drove out past the hills tonight. Same gear. Darker sky. Try again.
story.meaning_zh: 今晚俱乐部开车到了山那边。设备没变，天更暗了。再试一次。
story.maya_en: The club drove past the hills tonight. Same gear, darker sky—let's try that again.
story.maya_zh: 今晚社团开到了山外。设备没变，天更暗了——再试一次。

story.meaning_en: Remember the fireflies-in-a-lit-room problem from the city? Tonight we turned off the lamps. Same faint galaxy, but now the background is dark enough for it to stand out.
story.meaning_zh: 还记得城里那个'开灯房间找萤火虫'的难题吗？今晚我们把灯都关了。还是那个暗弱的星系，但现在背景够暗，它终于能显出来了。
story.maya_en: Remember trying to spot fireflies in a lit room back in the city? Tonight the lamps are off, and that same faint galaxy can finally stand out from the dark background.
story.maya_zh: 还记得在亮房间找萤火虫吗？今晚灯关了，同一个暗星系终于从背景里浮出来啦。

story.meaning_en: Give your eyes a few minutes out here too - they get more sensitive in the dark, a trick called dark adaptation. City lights never let that finish; out here, it can.
story.meaning_zh: 也让你的眼睛在这儿适应几分钟——在黑暗中它们会变得更敏感，这个技巧叫暗适应。城市的灯光从不让它完成；但在这儿可以。
story.maya_en: Give your eyes a few minutes. They'll grow more sensitive in the dark—that's dark adaptation. City lights keep interrupting it; out here, they won't.
story.maya_zh: 先让眼睛适应几分钟。暗处会渐渐变敏锐，这叫暗适应；城里的灯总会把它打断。

story.meaning_en: City sky and dark sky are the same telescope, the same eyepiece, the same target - only the background light changes, and yet everything changes with it.
story.meaning_zh: 城市天空和暗夜天空用的是同一台望远镜、同一个目镜、同一个目标——只有背景光变了，可一切都跟着变了。
story.maya_en: Same telescope, same eyepiece, same target. Only the background light changed—and look how much changed with it.
story.maya_zh: 望远镜、目镜、目标都没变，只换了背景光，看到的却完全不同。

story.meaning_en: Your telescope didn't improve overnight - your sky did.
story.meaning_zh: 你的望远镜一夜之间没有变好——变好的是你的天空。
story.maya_en: There it is! Your telescope didn't improve overnight—the sky did.
story.maya_zh: 看见了吧！不是望远镜一夜升级，是天空变好了。

story.meaning_en: Same aperture, same eyepiece, same everything - the only upgrade was leaving the city glow behind. Dark sky is the cheapest telescope upgrade that exists.
story.meaning_zh: 同样的口径，同样的目镜，什么都没变——唯一的升级是离开了城市的光。暗夜天空是存在的最便宜的'望远镜升级'。
story.maya_en: Same aperture, same eyepiece—the only upgrade was leaving the city glow behind. A dark sky is the cheapest telescope upgrade there is.
story.maya_zh: 口径、目镜都没换，只是离开了城市灯光。暗夜就是最便宜的望远镜升级。

story.meaning_en: Deep Sky Observer, logged. Now let's talk about why the sky keeps moving.
story.meaning_zh: 「深空观测者」记入日志。接下来，我们聊聊为什么天空一直在转。
story.maya_en: Deep-Sky Observer: logged! Next up—why the sky never seems to sit still.
story.maya_zh: 「深空观测者」记入日志！接着聊聊，天空为什么总在转。

story.meaning_en: Watch closely. The star is running away - no, the Earth is turning under you.
story.meaning_zh: 盯紧了。星星在慢慢逃——不，是地球在你脚下转。
story.maya_en: Watch closely. That star is slipping away—or rather, Earth is turning beneath your feet.
story.maya_zh: 盯紧喽。星星在溜走——其实，是地球在你脚下转。

story.meaning_en: Every star you've ever centered has been quietly drifting the whole time. At low magnification you barely notice. Crank up the power and suddenly it's racing across the view.
story.meaning_zh: 你以前对准的每一颗星星，其实一直都在悄悄漂移。低倍率下你几乎察觉不到，一旦倍率拉高，它就像在视野里飞奔。
story.maya_en: Every star you've centered was drifting all along. At low power you barely notice; raise the magnification, and it races across the view.
story.maya_zh: 以前对准的星其实一直在漂。低倍率不明显，倍率一高，它就飞快穿过视野。

story.meaning_en: The Earth spins once every 24 hours, so the whole sky appears to sweep past us at about 15 degrees an hour. Your telescope has no idea you want to keep looking at the same star - you have to fight that spin by hand tonight.
story.meaning_zh: 地球每 24 小时自转一圈，所以整个天空看起来每小时会掠过我们大约 15 度。望远镜可不知道你想一直盯着同一颗星——今晚你得徒手对抗这种自转。
story.maya_en: Earth turns once every 24 hours, so the sky appears to sweep by at about 15 degrees per hour. The telescope won't follow one star on its own—tonight, you'll counter that spin by hand.
story.maya_zh: 地球每24小时自转一圈，天空看起来每小时移动约15度。望远镜不会自己跟星，今晚得手动追踪。

story.meaning_en: Tonight's air is just average, nothing extra to fight - all your attention goes to keeping Sirius centered as it drifts.
story.meaning_zh: 今晚的空气只是一般水平，没有额外的麻烦——你可以把全部注意力都放在让天狼星保持居中上。
story.maya_en: The air is only average tonight, but there's no extra trouble. Put all your attention into following Sirius and keeping it centered.
story.maya_zh: 今晚空气稳定度一般，不过没别的干扰。专心跟着天狼星漂移，把它留在中央。

story.meaning_en: You just fought the planet's spin by hand. Feel the workout?
story.meaning_zh: 你刚才在徒手对抗地球自转。感觉到工作量了吧？
story.maya_en: You kept Sirius centered by fighting Earth's spin with your own hands. Quite a workout, huh?
story.maya_zh: 你真的徒手把天狼星留在中央了！对抗地球自转，够累吧？

story.meaning_en: This is exactly why long-exposure astrophotography needs a motor to track the sky - a human hand gets tired, a motor doesn't.
story.meaning_zh: 这正是为什么长曝光天文摄影需要电机来追踪天空——人手会累，电机不会。
story.maya_en: That's exactly why long-exposure astrophotography uses a motor to track the sky. Hands get tired; motors don't.
story.maya_zh: 所以长曝光天文摄影要用电机追踪天空呀——人手会累，电机可不会。

story.meaning_en: From now on, every drifting target you fight by hand is really just this same lesson, over and over.
story.meaning_zh: 从现在起，你每次徒手对抗漂移的目标，其实都是在重复这同一课。
story.maya_en: From here on, every drifting target you chase by hand is this same lesson in a new disguise.
story.maya_zh: 往后每次手动追漂移目标，练的其实都是这一课。

story.meaning_en: Tonight the tracking mount does the holding - which frees your eyes for something I want you to see on Vega.
story.meaning_zh: 今晚由追踪支架负责稳住目标——这样你的眼睛就腾出来了，我要你在织女星上看一样东西。
story.maya_en: Tonight, let the tracking mount hold the target steady. You just watch—there's a detail on Vega I want you to catch.
story.maya_zh: 今晚让追踪支架稳住目标。你只管看，我想让你留意织女星的一处细节。

story.meaning_en: Focus as carefully as you can, then stare at the star's edge. If you notice anything strange, it is NOT your mistake. Remember it.
story.meaning_zh: 尽你所能仔细调焦，然后盯住星的边缘。如果看到什么奇怪的东西，那不是你的失误。记住它。
story.maya_en: Focus as precisely as you can, then watch the star's edge. If something looks odd, don't blame yourself—remember it.
story.maya_zh: 先尽量调准焦，再盯住星点边缘。看到异样也别怪自己，把它记下来。

story.meaning_en: A violet-blue fringe remains around the star even at best focus. That points to chromatic aberration: the refractor does not bring every color to the same focus.
story.meaning_zh: 星点在最佳焦点附近仍带着紫蓝色彩边，这很可能是色差：折射镜没有把不同颜色的光聚在同一个焦点。
story.maya_en: The focus is as tight as we can make it, but that violet-blue fringe still clings to the star. It looks like chromatic aberration—the lens isn't bringing every color to the same focus.
story.maya_zh: 焦点已经尽量调准了，星点外那圈紫蓝彩边还是不肯走。很像色差——透镜没把不同颜色的光收在同一个焦点。

story.meaning_en: Finish your training first. But keep tonight's observation in your logbook - we will come back to it.
story.meaning_zh: 先把今晚的训练做完，记录也别删。后面换一种望远镜，我们再拿它来比。
story.maya_en: Finish tonight's training first, and keep that observation in your log. Later, we'll compare it through a different kind of telescope.
story.maya_zh: 先完成今晚的训练，别删观测记录。以后换种望远镜，我们再拿它比较。

story.meaning_en: One last lesson: deep sky rewards the patient. Stay with her.
story.meaning_zh: 最后一课：深空回报有耐心的人。陪着她，别走开。
story.maya_en: One last lesson: deep-sky detail comes to the patient. Stay with her.
story.maya_zh: 最后一课：深空只肯慢慢显出细节，耐心守住她。

story.meaning_en: Every trick you've learned - aperture, dark sky, tracking - comes together tonight.
story.meaning_zh: 口径、暗空、追踪——你学过的每一招，今晚都要用上。
story.maya_en: Tonight, aperture, dark skies, and tracking all come into play. Time to put everything you've learned together.
story.maya_zh: 今晚，口径、暗空和追踪要一起上场。把学过的本事都串起来吧。

story.meaning_en: The air is calm, just average seeing - I'm not adding a new obstacle tonight. This is a test of everything you already know, not a new lesson.
story.meaning_zh: 今晚空气平静，只是一般视宁度——我不会再给你加新的障碍了。这是对你已学一切的考验，不是新课。
story.maya_en: The air is calm and the seeing is average, so there are no new obstacles tonight. This is about using what you already know.
story.maya_zh: 空气很平静，视宁度普通，今晚没有新难题。这一关只看你能否用好已经学会的一切。

story.meaning_en: Andromeda will drift like every target does, thanks to the Earth's spin. Tonight the hold is strict - drift out of center for too long and the timer counts backward. Full focus, full patience.
story.meaning_zh: 仙女座和所有目标一样会漂移，这是地球自转造成的。今晚的居中判定很严格——漂出中心太久，计时会倒退。全神贯注，拿出耐心。
story.maya_en: Earth's rotation will keep Andromeda drifting. Centering is strict tonight: stay off-center too long and the timer runs backward. Focus, and be patient.
story.maya_zh: 地球自转会让仙女座持续漂移。今晚居中判定更严，离开中心太久，计时会倒退；专注，也耐心。

story.meaning_en: That was a complete refractor session, planned and executed without rescue. You have proved that the workflow works.
story.meaning_zh: 这次从选设备到观测，都是你自己完成的。折射镜这套操作，你已经能独立做了。
story.maya_en: You chose the gear, set it up, and made the observation all on your own. You've proved you can run the full refractor workflow.
story.maya_zh: 选设备、架设、观测，全是你独立完成。折射镜这套流程，你已经稳稳走通了。

story.meaning_en: One look at Vega's color fringe is not enough for a firm conclusion. Tomorrow, return to the same bright star with the refractor and refocus carefully to confirm whether the fringe persists. Maya left the next optical clue in the club storeroom.
story.meaning_zh: 只看一次织女星的彩边还不能下定论。明晚继续用折射镜观测同一颗亮星，认真重新调焦，确认彩边是否仍然存在。下一份光学线索在社团储藏室。
story.maya_en: One look at Vega's color fringe isn't enough to call it. Tomorrow we'll return to the same star, change nothing, and refocus carefully to see whether it stays. The next optical clue is in the club storeroom~
story.maya_zh: 织女星那圈彩边，光看一回还不能下结论。明晚再看同一颗星，什么都别乱换，只认真调焦核对一次。下一份光学线索在储藏室~

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Before using a telescope, you need to understand what your eyes can already detect and where their limits begin.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 先用肉眼看一次，记住现在能看到多少。以后换上望远镜，差别才会直观。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Take one good look with your own eyes first. Then you'll really feel what the telescope adds.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 先用自己的眼睛好好看看，之后换望远镜，差别才真切。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Use A/D and W/S to scan the sky. Put the Moon inside the central guide, then press Observe.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 用 A/D 和 W/S 扫视天空，把月球移入中央引导圈，再按“观测”。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Use A/D and W/S to sweep across the sky. Guide the Moon into the center circle, then press Observe.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 用 A/D 和 W/S 扫视天空，把月亮送进中央引导圈，再按“观测”。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: The Moon is centered, the lock turns gold, and Observe becomes available.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 月球居中后锁定环会变成金色，“观测”按钮也会变为可用。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: There you go—the Moon's sitting right in the circle, and Observe just lit up.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 看见了吗？月亮稳稳落在圈里，“观测”也亮起来了。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: If the Moon is outside the view, follow the edge arrow and its Az/Alt corrections instead of guessing.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 月球不在画面里时，先看边缘箭头。照着方位角和高度角提示转，比乱找快得多。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Moon slipped out of view? Follow the edge arrow and its Az/Alt hints—no need to guess.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 月亮跑出画面了？跟着边缘箭头和 Az/Alt 提示转，别靠猜。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: A bright Moon is easy, but a faint star tests how much light your eyes can collect.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 月球很亮，肉眼当然看得见。换成暗一点的恒星，你就会碰到肉眼的极限。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: The Moon is an easy catch because it's bright. A dimmer star is where your eyes really get tested.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 月亮亮，很容易看见；换成暗些的恒星，才真考验眼力。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Find Polaris with the wide naked-eye view. Use its direction and brightness, then center it carefully.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 先看方向提示，在肉眼的大视野里找到北极星，再把那个小星点移到中央。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Use the direction hint to find Polaris in the wide naked-eye view, then ease that tiny point into the center.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 看着方向提示，在肉眼的大视野里找北极星，再把小星点移到中央。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: A small stellar point is centered and the observation confirms that it is visible without magnification.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 小小的星点被居中，观测结果会确认它无需放大也能被看见。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: That's it—the tiny point is Polaris. You found it with your own eyes, no magnification needed.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 对，就是那个小星点。没放大，你也亲眼找到了北极星。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: If it seems lost, read the target arrow first; stars should remain tiny in naked-eye mode.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 找不到就先跟着方向箭头走。肉眼里的恒星本来就很小，不会突然变成一个大光球。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Can't spot it? Start with the target arrow. In naked-eye view, a star really is just a tiny point.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 一时找不到就先跟目标箭头走；肉眼里的恒星，本来就只是小星点。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: The lens must collect light and form a focused image before an eyepiece can magnify it.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 光先经过物镜会聚，再由目镜放大。顺序装错了，望远镜就成不了像。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: The objective has to gather the light and form an image before the eyepiece can magnify it. The order matters.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 得先让物镜聚光成像，目镜才能放大；这条光路的顺序不能乱。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: At the blueprint, select each required part and install it into the matching highlighted slot.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 先点左侧零件卡，再点蓝图中对应的高亮槽位。按物镜、镜筒、目镜的光路顺序装。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Choose a part card on the left, then its highlighted slot on the blueprint. Go objective, tube, then eyepiece.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 点左侧零件卡，再点蓝图中对应的高亮槽位；按物镜、镜筒、目镜来装。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Every required slot shows the real installed part, a green border, and an OK mark.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 所有必需槽位都会显示真实零件贴图、绿色边框和 OK 标记。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Nice—the objective, tube, and eyepiece are all in place. You've built the whole light path.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 漂亮，物镜、镜筒和目镜都接好了，整条光路已经搭起来了。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: A rejected part belongs to another slot or telescope family; read Compatibility in the Inspector.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 零件被退回来，通常是槽位不对或家族不兼容。右侧检查器会告诉你具体原因。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Part bounced back? Check Compatibility in the Inspector on the right—it'll point out the wrong slot or family.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 零件被退回了？看看右侧检查器的 Compatibility，是槽位还是家族不合。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: A telescope can point at the right object and still show a blurred image when the eyepiece is away from the focal plane.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 瞄准没错，画面也可能发糊。目镜还没落在焦平面上而已。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: You can aim perfectly and still get a blur. That just means the eyepiece hasn't reached the focal plane yet.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 瞄得再准也可能发糊，只是目镜还没落到焦平面上。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Turn the focus control with Q/E in small steps. Watch the edge, halo, and double image change continuously.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 用 Q/E 慢慢转调焦旋钮。别只盯百分比，看目标边缘、光晕和重影有没有收紧。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Nudge the focus with Q/E. Watch the edges, halo, and double image tighten up instead of chasing the percentage.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 用 Q/E 一点点调焦，盯着边缘、光晕和重影怎么收紧，别只追百分比。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: The image reaches its sharpest point, the focus feedback locks, and clarity agrees with the quality panel.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 图像收紧到最清楚时，对焦会锁定。右侧清晰度也会同时确认。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Right there—the edge is crisp, and the halo and double image have both settled down.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 就是这里——边缘利落，光晕和重影也都收住了。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: If it becomes worse, reverse direction and use shorter taps near the clearest point.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 如果越调越糊，就反向调整；接近最清晰位置时改用更短的点按。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: If it gets blurrier, go back the other way. Near the clearest point, use shorter taps.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 越调越糊就往回走，快到最清楚的位置时，改成短按。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: More magnification enlarges detail but narrows the field, dims the image, and makes drift more obvious.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 先别急着加倍率。目标会变大，但视野会变窄，画面也会更暗、更容易漂走。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: More magnification makes details bigger, but you lose some sky, brightness, and stability.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 倍率越高，细节越大，可视野会变窄、变暗，漂移也更明显。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Compare the available eyepieces. Start wide to locate the target, then change to the mission's requested magnification.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 先用低倍率把目标稳稳抓住，再换成任务要求的目镜。换完记得重新检查居中。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Compare the eyepieces first. Find the target at low power, then switch to the requested magnification and center it again.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 先比比几只目镜。低倍找到目标，再换成要求的倍率，重新把它放回中央。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: The target remains centered after the eyepiece change and the requested detail becomes visible.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 更换目镜后目标仍保持居中，并能看到任务要求的细节。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: There it is—the eyepiece change didn't lose the target, and now you can make out the detail.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 这就对了，换了目镜，目标没跑，细节也出来了。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: If the target vanishes after zooming in, return to the wider eyepiece, recenter, and try again.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 如果升倍率后目标消失，先换回宽视野目镜，重新居中后再试。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Lost it after zooming in? Switch back to the wider eyepiece, recenter it, and try again.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 升倍率后找不到了？换回宽视野目镜，重新对准，再试一次。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: The main telescope sees too little sky to search efficiently. A finder provides a wider intermediate view.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 主镜视野太窄，直接硬找很费劲。寻星镜就是中间那一步，先帮你把目标抓进来。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: The main telescope sees too little sky to search comfortably. The finder's wider view helps you bring the target in first.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 主镜视野太窄，不好直接搜；寻星镜视野更宽，能先帮你抓住目标。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Install the finder first. In Finder mode use I/J/K/L to move its crosshair onto the same target as the main telescope.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 先装上寻星镜。进入寻星镜模式后，用 I/J/K/L 把它的准星对到主镜看到的同一个目标。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Install the finder, enter Finder mode, then use I/J/K/L to put its crosshair on the same target as the main telescope.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 先装上寻星镜，进入寻星镜模式，再用 I/J/K/L 把准星移到主镜看到的同一目标上。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Delta Az and Delta Alt approach zero, the crosshair flashes gold once, and Finder aligned appears.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 当方位与高度误差接近零时，准星会短暂变金，并显示“寻星镜已对准”。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: See that gold flash? Nice—the finder and the main telescope are looking at the same spot now.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 看，准星闪金了！寻星镜和主镜现在看的是同一个地方。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: If the alignment gets worse, move one axis at a time and follow the sign of each delta.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 差值越调越大就反方向来。一次只动一个轴，会更容易看懂变化。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: If a delta grows, move the other way. Adjust one axis at a time so you can follow each change.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 差值越调越大就反向来，一次只动一个轴，变化会更好看懂。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Faint targets need more collected light, not merely more magnification.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 暗目标缺的是光，不是尺寸。只加倍率，往往只会得到一团更大的暗影。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: A faint target needs more light, not just a bigger image. More magnification alone only makes the dim blur larger.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 暗目标缺的是光，不是尺寸；只加倍率，不过是把暗影放大。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Choose the mission-compatible larger objective in the Parts Cabinet, equip it, then install it at the Assembly Table.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 去零件柜换上本关兼容的大口径物镜，再回组装台把它装进蓝图。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: In the Parts Cabinet, equip a larger objective that's compatible with this mission, then install it at the Assembly Table.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 去零件柜装备本关兼容的大口径物镜，再到组装台把它装进蓝图。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: The Inspector reports higher optics and the faint target becomes brighter without contradicting the quality readout.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 检查器会显示更高的光学性能，暗目标也会变亮，并与质量判定保持一致。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Much better—the faint target is brighter now. That larger aperture really is gathering more light.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 好多了，暗目标亮起来了；大口径确实收进了更多光。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: If it cannot be installed, verify telescope family, part type, and the mission's Required list.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 如果无法安装，请检查望远镜家族、零件类型和本关 Required 列表。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: If it won't install, check the telescope family, the part type, and this mission's Required list.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 装不上就查一下望远镜家族、零件类型，还有本关的 Required 列表。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Nebulae and galaxies spread their light over a large area, so contrast matters more than a bright central point.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 星云和星系的光摊得很开，不会像恒星那样亮成一个点。这里更看重对比度。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Nebulae and galaxies spread their light over a wide area instead of shining from one bright point, so contrast matters more here.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 星云和星系的光铺得很开，不会亮成一点，所以这里更看重对比度。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Use a wide eyepiece, let your eyes adapt, keep the target steady, and look for a faint extended glow.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 用宽视野目镜，等眼睛适应黑暗，再把目标稳住。慢慢找那团延展开的淡光。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Use a wide eyepiece, give your eyes time to adapt to the dark, and hold the target steady. Look slowly for a faint, spread-out glow.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 用宽视野目镜，等眼睛适应黑暗，把目标稳住，再慢慢找那片淡淡的延展光。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: A low-contrast shape becomes consistently visible and the quality panel reports enough light and stability.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 那团淡轮廓能稳定留在画面里，集光和稳定性也达标，就可以观测了。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: See that? That faint outline is holding steady now.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 看见了吗？那团淡淡的轮廓稳稳浮出来了。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: If only the center is visible, lower the magnification and improve darkness or stability before trying again.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 如果只能看见中心，先降低倍率，并改善黑暗环境或稳定性后再试。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Only the center is showing right now. Lower the magnification, then try again once it's darker and steadier.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 现在只看得到中心。先降点倍率，等环境更暗、画面更稳再试。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: A refractor bends different colours by slightly different amounts, creating coloured fringes around bright targets.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 看到亮星边缘的彩色条纹了吗？这不是你手抖，是折射镜对不同颜色弯折得不一样。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: That colored rim around the bright star isn't your hand shaking. A refractor bends each color a little differently.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 亮星边上那圈彩色，不是你手抖。折射镜会让不同颜色弯得不太一样。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Focus as accurately as possible, then inspect the star's edge. Compare a real colour fringe with simple defocus.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 先把星点调到最清楚，再看边缘。如果中心清楚、彩边还在，那才是色差。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Get the star as sharp as you can, then check its edge. If the center is sharp but the color remains, that's chromatic aberration.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 先把星点调到最清楚，再看边缘。中心清楚、彩边还在，才是色差。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: You identify the fringe while the center remains focused, proving that the lens rather than your focus is responsible.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 中心已经清楚，彩边却没消失。可以确认了：是透镜的色差，不是你没调好焦。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Yep, that's it—the center is sharp, but the colored rim is still there. Your focus is fine.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 对，就是它：中心明明清楚，彩边却还在。你的对焦没问题。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: If the whole star is soft, adjust focus first; do not label blur as chromatic aberration.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 如果整颗星都发糊，先重新调焦；不要把普通模糊误判为色差。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: If the whole star looks soft, refocus first. Plain old blur isn't chromatic aberration.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 整颗星都糊的话，先重新对焦；普通失焦可别当成色差。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Faint extended light is easier to detect with dark-adapted peripheral vision than with the center of your retina.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 暗东西别死盯中心。眼睛适应黑暗后，用旁边一点的视野反而更容易看见。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Don't stare straight at something this faint. Once your eyes adjust to the dark, your peripheral vision can pick it up more easily.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 暗淡的天体别死盯中心。眼睛适应黑暗后，用旁边的视野反而更容易看见。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Wait for dark adaptation, hold Shift, and keep the target slightly beside the center marker instead of staring directly at it.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 先让目标保持居中，望远镜别动。暗适应完成后按住 Shift，视线标记会移到目标旁边。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Let your eyes adjust first, then hold Shift and look just beside the target instead of staring at its center.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 先等暗适应，再按住 Shift，让视线落在目标旁边，别直盯中心。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: The averted-vision status activates and the faint structure gains contrast without changing its real position.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 保持片刻后侧视法会就绪，暗结构会更容易冒出来，目标位置不会改变。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: There—the faint structure just came out. The object didn't move; your averted vision kicked in.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 看，刚才藏着的暗纹理浮出来了；天体没动，是你的侧视起作用了。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: If the effect is inactive, move the target just off-center and keep your gaze steady for the required time.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 还没生效就继续按住 Shift，并保持望远镜不动。别用 W/S/A/D 把目标推开。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Keep holding Shift and leave the telescope still—don't touch W/S/A/D. Hold your gaze beside the target for a moment.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 继续按住 Shift，望远镜别动，也别碰 W/S/A/D；把视线稳在目标旁边一会儿。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: The sky appears to drift because Earth rotates. High magnification makes that drift impossible to ignore.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 目标自己慢慢滑走，是地球自转造成的。倍率越高，这种漂移越难忽略。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: It isn't wandering off on its own—the Earth is turning beneath us. At high magnification, that drift is hard to miss.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 它慢慢滑走不是自己在跑，是地球在转；倍率一高，就更藏不住了。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Enable tracking and adjust the rate near 1.0x. Watch whether the target drifts, holds, or moves backward.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 打开追踪，把速率往 1.0x 附近调。目标继续原方向漂就加一点，反向漂就减一点。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Turn tracking on and set the rate near 1.0x. If it keeps drifting the same way, nudge it up; if it reverses, nudge it down.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 打开追踪，把速率调到 1.0x 附近。还顺着漂就加一点，反向漂就减一点。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: The target remains inside the hold range and the progress bar grows continuously.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 目标持续留在保持范围内，进度条会平滑增长。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Nice, it's staying put in the view now. You dialed that tracking rate in really well.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 稳住了，它一直待在视野里。这个追踪速率调得很准。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: If it moves in the same direction, increase the rate; if it reverses, reduce the rate.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 如果目标仍沿原方向漂移就提高速率；如果反向漂移就降低速率。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: If it's still drifting the same way, raise the rate a little. If it starts drifting backward, lower it again.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 还沿原方向漂，就把速率加一点；要是反向漂，再减一点。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Moving air bends light from moment to moment, so a correctly focused target can still shimmer or boil.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 焦点对了，画面还在抖或边缘像沸腾，那就是大气在动，不是旋钮坏了。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: If it's in focus but still shimmers or seems to boil at the edges, moving air is bending the light. The focus knob isn't broken.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 焦点对了还会抖、边缘像在翻滚，是空气流动在弯折光线，不是旋钮坏了。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Focus carefully, then observe the motion over time. Separate temporary atmospheric distortion from a persistent focus error.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 先把焦点调好，再看几秒。失焦会一直糊，大气扰动会一阵清楚、一阵发抖。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Get the focus right first, then watch for a few seconds. Constant blur means bad focus; brief sharp moments mixed with wobble are the atmosphere.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 先把焦点调准，再多看几秒。一直糊是失焦，忽清忽抖才是大气扰动。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: You wait for steadier moments and capture enough stable detail for the observation.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 你能等待较稳定的瞬间，并获得足够清晰稳定的观测细节。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Yes, that steady moment! You caught the detail beautifully.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 对，就是稳下来的那一瞬！细节抓得很漂亮。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: If the image never settles, reduce magnification or wait; turning the focus knob cannot fix poor seeing.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 如果画面始终不稳定，就降低倍率或等待；调焦旋钮无法修复糟糕的视宁度。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: If it never stops wobbling, leave the focus knob alone. Drop the magnification or wait for steadier air.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 一直抖就别拧调焦旋钮了，降点倍率，或者耐心等它稳下来。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: A larger image is not automatically a better image; excessive power magnifies blur, seeing and tracking error.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 画面变大，不代表细节变多。倍率太高，模糊、大气抖动和追踪误差都会一起被放大。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: More magnification isn't always better. It enlarges the blur, atmospheric wobble, and tracking errors too.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 倍率不是越高越好；画面放大时，模糊、抖动和追踪误差也会一起放大。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Compare two eyepieces and choose the highest magnification that still preserves brightness, stability and detail.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 比较两枚目镜，选择仍能保持亮度、稳定性和细节的最高有效倍率。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Try both eyepieces and keep the highest power that still looks bright, steady, and detailed.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 两枚目镜都试试，选画面仍然明亮、稳定、细节清楚的最高倍率。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Surface detail improves while quality remains above the mission threshold.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 表面细节得到提升，同时观测质量仍高于任务门槛。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Nice choice—the surface detail is clearer, and the view is still steady.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 这档倍率选得漂亮，表面细节更清楚，画面也还稳着。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: If the image grows but detail does not, step back to the lower magnification.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 如果画面变大但细节没有增加，就退回较低倍率。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: If it only gets bigger, not clearer, step back to the lower magnification. It'll actually look better.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 只变大没变清楚，就退回低一档倍率，反而更好看。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Cloud cover changes with time and can dim a target even when aim, focus and equipment are correct.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 设备都调对了，云还是会把目标挡住。这种时候别乱动焦点。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Even with the focus and equipment set correctly, a cloud can still dim the target. Don't rush to refocus.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 焦点和设备没问题，云照样会把目标压暗；这时别急着重新调焦。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Watch the cloud layer cross the target and wait for a clear interval before committing the observation.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 把目标稳在中央，等云层移开。亮度恢复后再按观测。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Hold the target steady and wait for the cloud to move on. Once the brightness returns, press Observe.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 先稳住目标，等云移开、亮度回来，再按下“观测”。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Target brightness recovers, cloud obstruction falls, and the quality panel confirms a usable window.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 目标亮度恢复、云层遮挡降低，质量面板会确认当前窗口可用。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: You caught the break in the clouds! The target is bright again, and this view is beautifully clear.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 云缝赶上了！目标重新亮起来，这一眼真清楚。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Do not chase cloud dimming with focus. Keep the target centered and wait or change site.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 云挡住了就等一等。天文观测有时候就是这么磨人，也可以换个地点试试。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Don't chase a cloud with the focus knob. Keep the target centered and wait it out; if it lingers, use Change Site.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 别拿调焦追着云跑。保持目标在中央，等云过去；不行就点“更换地点”。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Artificial sky glow reduces contrast and hides faint targets even when the telescope itself is unchanged.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 城市灯光会把夜空抬亮，暗目标就被背景吞掉了。望远镜没坏，是天空不够黑。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: The telescope is fine. City glow brightens the sky behind the target, so faint objects get washed out.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 望远镜没坏，是城市天光把背景照亮了，暗目标就容易被淹没。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: Observe the same kind of faint target under the current sky brightness, then compare it with the darker-site result.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 先记下当前地点能看到多少，再换到更暗的站点看同类目标。两次结果放在一起比。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: Note what you can see here, then view the same kind of target from a darker site and compare the two.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 先记下这里能看到的细节，再去更暗的地点看同类目标，把两次结果放一起比。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: The darker site reveals more faint structure while equipment and aiming remain comparable.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 在设备和瞄准条件相近时，更暗地点会显现更多暗弱结构。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: See the difference? The darker site brings out much more of that faint structure.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 看见差别了吧？更暗的地点露出了更多微弱结构。

skill_tutorials.meaning_en: If the target is washed out, lower unnecessary magnification, improve dark adaptation, or use Change Site.
skill_tutorials.meaning_zh: 如果目标被天光淹没，请降低不必要的倍率、改善暗适应，或使用“更换地点”。
skill_tutorials.maya_en: If sky glow washes it out, lower any unnecessary magnification, let your eyes adapt to the dark, or choose Change Site.
skill_tutorials.maya_zh: 目标被天光冲淡时，降低不必要的倍率，让眼睛适应黑暗，或点“更换地点”。

runtime_supplements.context_zh: 新人第一次去中央观测台前
runtime_supplements.meaning_en: The first ten lessons stay at the club. Walk to the Observation Pad with WASD, press E, then use A/D and W/S to center the Moon. Maya remains in the hall and waits for the log.
runtime_supplements.meaning_zh: 前十节基础课都在俱乐部。用 WASD 走到观测台，按 E 进入，再用 A/D、W/S 居中月球。玛雅留在大厅等日志。
runtime_supplements.maya_en: We'll do the first ten lessons here at the club. Use WASD to walk to the Observation Pad and press E to enter, then use A/D and W/S to center the Moon. I'll stay in the hall and wait for your observing log.
runtime_supplements.maya_zh: 前十节基础课都在社团里完成。你先用 WASD 走到观测台，按 E 进入，再用 A/D 和 W/S 把月球移到中央。我会留在大厅等你的观测日志。

runtime_supplements.context_zh: 第一次肉眼观月操作说明之后
runtime_supplements.meaning_en: Tonight's naked-eye record will be compared with crater rims seen through a refractor on the next Moon visit.
runtime_supplements.meaning_zh: 今晚的肉眼记录会在下一次观月时，与折射镜看到的环形山边缘作比较。
runtime_supplements.maya_en: Keep tonight's naked-eye record. Next time we'll use a refractor to see the crater rims and compare the two~
runtime_supplements.maya_zh: 今晚这份肉眼记录要留好哦。下次换折射镜看环形山边缘，两份日志正好对照~

runtime_supplements.meaning_en: Align the finder and main telescope on Sirius. The observing order is: eyes for direction, finder to catch the target, then switch to the main telescope for detail.
runtime_supplements.meaning_zh: 先用天狼星对齐寻星镜和主镜。观测顺序是：肉眼认方向，寻星镜抓目标，再切到主镜看细节。
runtime_supplements.maya_en: First, use Sirius to align the finder with the main telescope. When you observe, follow this order: get your bearings with your eyes, catch the target in the finder, then switch to the main telescope for the details.
runtime_supplements.maya_zh: 先用天狼星把寻星镜和主镜对齐。观测时按这个顺序来：先用肉眼认方向，再用寻星镜捕捉目标，最后切到主镜看细节。
